parents.course: Sem in Wrks of Select Composer

ns2:section.sectionText: This course is an investigation into the music of Beethoven, with special attention given to aesthetics, cultural and political background, analysis, creative process, and performance. Members of the seminar should obtain my book Beethoven (Oxford University Press, expanded edition 2009); other readings will be placed on reserve. A Chinese translation of this book is available, made by Dr. Liu Xiaolong.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MMUS:Music -UIUC, PHD:Musicology -UIUC, or AMUSD:Music -UIUC.
